name: tell_steel_glint
for: tell for any steel blow (husk chop/late chop, lancer thrust, butcher cleave, statue stone blade, priest mace, wraith reap): at Blow.tell / Attack tell
anchor_note: anchor_px = the hilt end of the edge; the edge runs +x to the tip at (47,7) where the star flares
faces: right (+x along the blade, hilt to tip); rotate it to the blade angle on the live frame (the game already turns streak frames in fx.rs) and scale it to the blade length (42 px edge = 0.68 m at 62 px/m)
notes: A cold sheen runs hilt to tip along the edge (frames 1-4), then a hand-drawn 8-point glint star pops at the tip (23x9 px at its peak, white core, 1-px spikes fading to steel at the tips), holds a frame and shrinks out. Small but unmissable: the only white on the foe. Hand-drawn star frames (image layer), not a generated blur.
